checksums.description: U32 word-sum over the whole 512-byte image with the stored word zeroed; matches FUN_08003d58 (via FUN_08003d14) and verifies against baseline (0xD9E6).
checksums.name: save_checksum

fields.description: First persisted gameplay-state word: EEPROM block 0, RAM-save word 0. Whole image is transferred in 8-byte blocks; this is the first word, zero in defaults and baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003c5c loops EEPROM blocks (param_1 = param_1 + 8) into the RAM save buffer from file offset 0; FUN_08003cb0 writes blocks back; FUN_08003d58 loads 0x200 bytes at boot; FUN_08003d14 covers this word in the checksum.
fields.name: gameplay_word_0

fields.description: Persisted gameplay-state word 1 (EEPROM block 0, second word). Zero in defaults and baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003c5c / FUN_08003cb0 8-byte block IO from file offset 0; FUN_08002cb04 stages each block as 4 u16 words; FUN_08003d58 validates and FUN_08003d14 checksums the image.
fields.name: gameplay_word_1

fields.description: Persisted gameplay-state word 2 (EEPROM block 0, third word). Zero in defaults and baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003c5c / FUN_08003cb0 8-byte block IO from file offset 0; FUN_08002cb04 stages each block as 4 u16 words; FUN_08003d58 validates and FUN_08003d14 checksums the image.
fields.name: gameplay_word_2

fields.description: Persisted gameplay-state word 3 (EEPROM block 0, fourth word). Zero in defaults and baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003c5c / FUN_08003cb0 8-byte block IO from file offset 0; FUN_08002cb04 stages each block as 4 u16 words; FUN_08003d58 validates and FUN_08003d14 checksums the image.
fields.name: gameplay_word_3

fields.description: Bulk persisted save area (EEPROM blocks 1-61 and block 62 head). Zeroed by save-init defaults; FUN_08003d58 additionally requires large sub-ranges to sum to zero; all zeros in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003d2c clears the buffer with FUN_08000c58; FUN_08003d58 enforces zero-sum over 59 consecutive 8-byte chunks (0x3b loop) plus an 8-byte header word check; FUN_08003d14 covers the area in the checksum.
fields.name: save_data_area

fields.description: ASCII save tag written by save-init; reads KONAMI in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003d2c copies the ROM tag string to buffer+0x1f0 with FUN_08000c70 (strcpy); baseline rev8-logical bytes at 0x1F0-0x1F5 are 4B 4F 4E 41 4D 49 (KONAMI).
fields.name: footer_tag

fields.description: NUL terminator of the save tag written by the init strcpy; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c70 (strcpy) used by FUN_08003d2c always stores a trailing NUL; baseline byte at 0x1F6 is 0x00.
fields.name: footer_tag_nul

fields.description: Zero gap between the tag terminator and the stored checksum; cleared by save-init and covered by the checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003d2c memsets the buffer via FUN_08000c58 before writing the tag; FUN_08003d14 checksums the whole image; baseline bytes 0x1F7-0x1FB are zero.
fields.name: footer_gap

magic_signatures.description: ASCII KONAMI tag at logical offset 0x1F0 (rev8 domain); written by FUN_08003d2c.
